description: WakeUp Component Types and Perspective Rules Fact Source v2

types.name: 近战武器
types.colorSpec: Primary: CORAL (warm orange-red) for melee attack identity. Secondary: dark steel gray, worn leather grip. Highlight: silver edge.
types.description: 近战冷兵器与破坏工具，强调动作感与打击面

types.name: 远程武器
types.colorSpec: Primary: PURPLE accent (long-range / relationship constraint). Secondary: matte dark gray composite, tan strap. Highlight: silver.

types.name: 枪械武器
types.colorSpec: Primary: gunmetal gray-blue with ORANGE accent (consumes AP / ammo). Secondary: dark polymer, brass casing detail. Highlight: silver slide.
types.description: 热兵器、枪械与爆炸物发射装置

types.name: 消耗品
types.colorSpec: Primary: GREEN (positive / safe / free) or ORANGE (consumption). Secondary: white bandage / amber liquid / paper wrap. Highlight: bright green accent.
types.description: 药剂、食物、燃料等一次性或有耐久的消耗物品

types.name: 工具
types.colorSpec: Primary: ORANGE (action / in-progress) or YELLOW (senses / attention). Secondary: black rubber grip, steel. Highlight: silver.
types.description: 钥匙、撬棍、扳手、探测器等用于检定或交互的手持工具

types.name: 装备
types.colorSpec: Primary: BLUE (tech / exhaustion-adjacent utility). Secondary: gray fabric, dark straps. Highlight: cyan-blue edge.
types.description: 护甲、头盔、腰带、背包等单人佩戴装备

types.name: 装置设施
types.colorSpec: Primary: off-white gray (interactive-but-state-bound) with BLUE tech accent. Secondary: dark screen, metal casing. Highlight: white edge glow when active.
types.description: 配电箱、终端机、监控雷达、研究台等可交互装置

types.name: 环境原生组件
types.colorSpec: Primary: muted low-saturation gray/brown matching the sketch-line background, with clear hard silhouette. Secondary: wood / concrete / metal. Highlight: subtle.
types.description: 门、闸机、箱柜、落地掩体等固定环境建筑或底图原生组件

perspectiveRules.itemPerspectiveDescription: 眼平直接正交正视图，强调物品清晰剪影与细节，无俯仰角度、无三维倾斜深度、无侧立面、无透视消失点
perspectiveRules.spatialPerspectiveDescription: 正面高位斜测轴：顶部与前部可见，侧部与后部隐藏，固定常规斜角，正交投影
